current_step.name: Conduct operational review of exceptions
current_step.description: An operations analyst reviews exception items using existing records and procedures. Depending on the circumstances, the analyst may compare the broker confirmation with the order history, contact the relevant operations or trading team, or obtain a corrected confirmation. Items that cannot be resolved using available trade records are escalated according to the existing settlement operations procedure.

problem_statement: Exception reviews are handled case by case using broker confirmations, order histories, settlement records, operating procedures, and input from operations or trading teams. Analysts must locate the relevant evidence, compare potentially inconsistent trade details, determine whether a discrepancy can be resolved, request corrected documentation when necessary, and escalate unresolved items under the settlement operations procedure. The work is operationally recurring but requires contextual judgment, and an incorrect resolution or unsupported closure could affect settlement accuracy, auditability, and financial processing.
proposed_design: Deploy a bounded Exception Evidence Agent that works only within approved trade-record repositories and settlement procedures. For each exception, the agent retrieves the relevant broker confirmation and order history, compares key fields such as security, side, quantity, price, trade date, settlement date, account, and counterparty, and produces an evidence-linked discrepancy summary. It may recommend one of four paths: resolve from existing records, contact the relevant operations or trading team, request a corrected broker confirmation, or escalate under the existing settlement operations procedure. The agent cannot close an exception, alter source records, send external communications, accept a corrected confirmation, or determine that an item is immaterial. It prepares a structured case packet for an operations analyst, who approves the disposition. After approval, the agent drafts the internal request or escalation package and records the approved rationale for audit review.
